evidence: The report covers PowerToys v0.100.1, installed via GitHub, affecting Crop and Lock, ZoomIt.

Reported reproduction: 1. Open any application (for example a browser). 2. Use ZoomIt draw/annotation mode (Ctrl+2) to draw annotations on top . 3. Use Crop And Lock in Screenshot mode (Win+Ctrl+Shift+S) to create a static cropped screenshot of that window. 4. Observe the resulting screenshot window.

Reported result: After a recent update, the cropped screenshot is completely black . Neither the plan content nor the ZoomIt annotations are captured. Taking a screenshot crop of an existing cropped window fails the same way (black). [attached image]

Expected result: The static screenshot shows the selected area including the ZoomIt annotations drawn on top . Previously I could also draw new ZoomIt annotations over the cropped screenshot window and take another screenshot crop of it, and those new annotations were captured too. [attached image]

title: [Crop And Lock] Screenshot mode produces a black image instead of capturing ZoomIt annotations after recent update
author: HasaniJeton
summary: The Crop and Lock, ZoomIt report describes after a recent update, the cropped screenshot is completely black . Neither the plan content nor the ZoomIt annotations are captured. Taking a screenshot crop of an existing cropped window fails the same way (black). [attached image].

proposed_fixes.title: Capture ZoomIt overlay content in Crop And Lock screenshot mode
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The current screenshot capture path does not include the ZoomIt annotation overlay and can return a black surface when the selected target contains that overlay or another Crop And Lock window.
plan: Compare the v0.99 and v0.100 screenshot capture paths for overlay and composed-window handling.
Select a capture method that includes the composed ZoomIt overlay while avoiding recursive capture of Crop And Lock windows.
Add regression coverage for annotated windows and nested screenshot-mode captures.
verification: Draw with ZoomIt, capture the annotated region in Crop And Lock screenshot mode, and confirm that the content and annotation appear rather than a black image.

confidence.rationale: The report gives a version regression and deterministic cross-module sequence, but the exact capture API regression requires source and runtime confirmation.
